name: @goodandready/dsh-russian-lang
description: Russian localization for DeepSeek Harness (DSH v0.1.7-rc.1+) web UI: adds Русский as native language option. 100.0% coverage across 11,295 keys (127 namespaces). Features full DSH v0.1.7-rc.1 core support (terminal, archive, command palette, Auto review, trajectory, PTC/Creator presets) and complete GoodAndReady plugin catalog (subscriptions, tts, image-gen, voice, key-limits, notify, commandcode, plugin-console).

scripts.check: python3 build.py --check && python3 tools/lint_translations.py && python3 check-coverage.py && python3 tools/term_check.py --ci && python3 tools/check_pack_size.py && python3 tools/check_data_integrity.py
scripts.test: node --test test/*.mjs && node test/_repro.cjs && python3 test/test_tools.py && python3 test/test_extract.py && python3 test/test_overflow.py
